title: Defu array-replacement merge export
description: TypeScript API change used to smoke-test automatic guarded routing.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The named defuArrayReplace export replaces arrays recursively with correct multi-default priority.
Nullish, non-array, immutability, and prototype-pollution behavior remains compatible.
Types, ESM/CJS exports, build output, and documentation expose the new API.
The upstream regression suite remains green.
